verses.en: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.pt: E passando Jesus, viu um homem cego de nascença.
verses.en_web: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
verses.en_bbe: And when he went on his way, he saw a man blind from birth.

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe os seus discípulos: Rabi, quem pecou, este ou seus pais, para que nascesse cego?
verses.en_web: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
verses.en_bbe: And his disciples put a question to him, saying, Master, was it because of this man's sin, or the sin of his father and mother, that he has been blind from birth?

verses.en: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: Nem ele pecou nem seus pais; mas foi para que nele se manifestem as obras de Deus.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, It was not because of his sin, or because of his father's or mother's; it was so that the works of God might be seen openly in him.

verses.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.pt: Importa que façamos as obras daquele que me enviou, enquanto é dia; vem a noite, quando ninguém pode trabalhar.
verses.en_web: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.en_bbe: While it is day we have to do the works of him who sent me: the night comes when no work may be done.

verses.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.pt: Enquanto estou no mundo, sou a luz do mundo.
verses.en_web: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
verses.en_bbe: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

verses.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.pt: Dito isto, cuspiu no chão e com a saliva fez lodo, e untou com lodo os olhos do cego,
verses.en_web: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,
verses.en_bbe: Having said these words, he put earth, mixed with water from his mouth, on the man's eyes,

verses.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.pt: e disse-lhe: Vai, lava-te no tanque de Siloé (que significa Enviado). E ele foi, lavou-se, e voltou vendo.
verses.en_web: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
verses.en_bbe: And said to him, Go and make yourself clean in the bath of Siloam (the sense of the name is, Sent). So he went away and, after washing, came back able to see.

verses.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.pt: Então os vizinhos e aqueles que antes o tinham visto, quando mendigo, perguntavam: Não é este o mesmo que se sentava a mendigar?
verses.en_web: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the neighbours and others who had seen him before in the street, with his hand out for money, said, Is not this the man who got money from people?

verses.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.pt: Uns diziam: É ele. E outros: Não é, mas se parece com ele. Ele dizia: Sou eu.
verses.en_web: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
verses.en_bbe: Some said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he.

verses.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe, pois: Como se te abriram os olhos?
verses.en_web: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
verses.en_bbe: So they said to him, How then were your eyes made open?

verses.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: O homem que se chama Jesus fez lodo, untou-me os olhos, e disse-me: Vai a Siloé e lava-te. Fui, pois, lavei-me, e fiquei vendo.
verses.en_web: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”
verses.en_bbe: His answer was: The man who is named Jesus put earth mixed with water on my eyes, and said to me, Go and make yourself clean in Siloam: so I went away and, after washing, am now able to see.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.pt: E perguntaram-lhe: Onde está ele? Respondeu: Não sei.
verses.en_web: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Where is he? His answer was: I have no knowledge.

verses.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.pt: Levaram aos fariseus o que fora cego.
verses.en_web: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
verses.en_bbe: They took him before the Pharisees--this man who had been blind.

verses.en: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.pt: Ora, era sábado o dia em que Jesus fez o lodo e lhe abriu os olhos.
verses.en_web: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
verses.en_bbe: Now the day on which the earth was mixed by Jesus and the man's eyes were made open was the Sabbath.

verses.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.pt: Então os fariseus também se puseram a perguntar-lhe como recebera a vista. Respondeu-lhes ele: Pôs-me lodo sobre os olhos, lavei-me e vejo.
verses.en_web: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”
verses.en_bbe: So the Pharisees put more questions to him about how his eyes had been made open. And he said to them, He put earth on my eyes, and I had a wash and am able to see.

verses.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.pt: Por isso alguns dos fariseus diziam: Este homem não é de Deus; pois não guarda o sábado. Diziam outros: Como pode um homem pecador fazer tais sinais? E havia dissensão entre eles.
verses.en_web: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” There was division among them.
verses.en_bbe: Then some of the Pharisees said, That man has not come from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath. Others said, How is it possible for a sinner to do such signs? So there was a division among them.

verses.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.pt: Tornaram, pois, a perguntar ao cego: Que dizes tu a respeito dele, visto que te abriu os olhos? E ele respondeu: É profeta.
verses.en_web: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
verses.en_bbe: Again they said to the blind man, What have you to say about him for opening your eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.

verses.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.pt: Os judeus, porém, não acreditaram que ele tivesse sido cego e recebido a vista, enquanto não chamaram os pais do que fora curado,
verses.en_web: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
verses.en_bbe: Now the Jews had no belief in the statement that he had been blind and was now able to see, till they sent for the father and mother of the man whose eyes had been made open,

verses.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.pt: e lhes perguntaram: É este o vosso filho, que dizeis ter nascido cego? Como, pois, vê agora?
verses.en_web: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
verses.en_bbe: And put the question to them, saying, Is this your son, of whom you say that he was blind at birth? how is it then that he is now able to see?

verses.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.pt: Responderam seus pais: Sabemos que este é o nosso filho, e que nasceu cego;
verses.en_web: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.en_bbe: In answer his father and mother said, We are certain that this is our son and that he was blind at birth:

verses.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.pt: mas como agora vê, não sabemos; ou quem lhe abriu os olhos, nós não sabemos; perguntai a ele mesmo; tem idade; ele falará por si mesmo.
verses.en_web: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
verses.en_bbe: But how it is he is now able to see, or who made his eyes open, we are not able to say: put the question to him; he is old enough to give an answer for himself.

verses.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.pt: Isso disseram seus pais, porque temiam os judeus, porquanto já tinham estes combinado que se alguém confessasse ser Jesus o Cristo, fosse expulso da sinagoga.
verses.en_web: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
verses.en_bbe: They said this because of their fear of the Jews: for the Jews had come to an agreement that if any man said that Jesus was the Christ he would be put out of the Synagogue.

verses.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.pt: Por isso é que seus pais disseram: Tem idade, perguntai-lho a ele mesmo.
verses.en_web: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
verses.en_bbe: That was the reason why they said, He is old enough; put the question to him.

verses.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.pt: Então chamaram pela segunda vez o homem que fora cego, e lhe disseram: Dá glória a Deus; nós sabemos que esse homem é pecador.
verses.en_web: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”
verses.en_bbe: So they sent a second time for the man who had been blind and they said to him, Give glory to God: it is clear to us that this man is a sinner.

verses.en: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Se é pecador, não sei; uma coisa sei: eu era cego, e agora vejo.
verses.en_web: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
verses.en_bbe: He said in answer, I have no knowledge if he is a sinner or not, but one thing I am certain about; I was blind, and now I see.

verses.en: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe pois: Que foi que te fez? Como te abriu os olhos?
verses.en_web: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
verses.en_bbe: Then they said to him, What did he do to you? how did he give you the use of your eyes?

verses.en: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes: Já vo-lo disse, e não atendestes; para que o quereis tornar a ouvir? Acaso também vós quereis tornar-vos discípulos dele?
verses.en_web: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”
verses.en_bbe: His answer was: I have said it before, but your ears were shut: why would you have me say it again? is it your desire to become his disciples?

verses.en: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.
verses.pt: Então o injuriaram, e disseram: Discípulo dele és tu; nós porém, somos discípulos de Moisés.
verses.en_web: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And they were angry with him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

verses.en: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.pt: Sabemos que Deus falou a Moisés; mas quanto a este, não sabemos donde é.
verses.en_web: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”
verses.en_bbe: We are certain that God gave his word to Moses: but as for this man, we have no knowledge where he comes from.

verses.en: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes o homem: Nisto, pois, está a maravilha: não sabeis donde ele é, e entretanto ele me abriu os olhos;
verses.en_web: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
verses.en_bbe: The man said in answer, Why, here is a strange thing! You have no knowledge where he comes from though he gave me the use of my eyes.

verses.en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
verses.pt: sabemos que Deus não ouve a pecadores; mas, se alguém for temente a Deus, e fizer a sua vontade, a esse ele ouve.
verses.en_web: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
verses.en_bbe: We have knowledge that God does not give ear to sinners, but if any man is a worshipper of God and does his pleasure, to him God's ears are open.

verses.en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.pt: Desde o princípio do mundo nunca se ouviu que alguém abrisse os olhos a um cego de nascença.
verses.en_web: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
verses.en_bbe: In all the years nobody has ever before seen the eyes of a man blind from birth made open.

verses.en: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
verses.pt: Se este não fosse de Deus, nada poderia fazer.
verses.en_web: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
verses.en_bbe: If this man did not come from God he would be unable to do anything.

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.pt: Replicaram-lhe eles: Tu nasceste todo em pecados, e vens nos ensinar a nós? E expulsaram-no.
verses.en_web: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” They threw him out.
verses.en_bbe: Their answer was: You came to birth through sin; do you make yourself our teacher? And they put him out of the Synagogue.

verses.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
verses.pt: Soube Jesus que o haviam expulsado; e achando-o perguntou- lhe: Crês tu no Filho do homem?
verses.en_web: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
verses.en_bbe: It came to the ears of Jesus that they had put him out, and meeting him he said, Have you faith in the Son of man?

verses.en: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Quem é, senhor, para que nele creia?
verses.en_web: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”
verses.en_bbe: He said in answer, And who is he, Lord? Say, so that I may have faith in him.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Já o viste, e é ele quem fala contigo.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, You have seen him; it is he who is talking to you.

verses.en: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.pt: Disse o homem: Creio, Senhor! E o adorou.
verses.en_web: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Lord, I have faith. And he gave him worship.

verses.en: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.pt: Prosseguiu então Jesus: Eu vim a este mundo para juízo, a fim de que os que não vêem vejam, e os que vêem se tornem cegos.
verses.en_web: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said, I came into this world to be a judge, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind.

verses.en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.pt: Alguns fariseus que ali estavam com ele, ouvindo isso, perguntaram-lhe: Porventura somos nós também cegos?
verses.en_web: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”
verses.en_bbe: These words came to the ears of the Pharisees who were with him and they said to him, Are we, then, blind?

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Se fosseis cegos, não teríeis pecado; mas como agora dizeis: Nós vemos, permanece o vosso pecado.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, If you were blind you would have no sin: but now that you say, We see; your sin is there still.
